995.41.10(1).explanation: The Multi-tenant House Overlay Map labels where the dwelling-room maximum differs: 12 rooms in one R-zone special area, 6 in another, and otherwise the zone's own 6, 12 or 25 room maximum (6 for R-type zones, 12 for RA/RAC/RM, 25 for CR/CRE).
